title: Beware of Impersonation Accounts
summary: Please be especially careful of impersonation accounts offering financial advice.
content:
I do not give direct advice on finance or stock investing, and I never message anyone first about these matters.

Over the past few days, I’ve received many reports of accounts impersonating me on Facebook, Kakao, Telegram, and other platforms. I’m sharing this notice to help prevent anyone from being harmed.

Thank you.
❤28🙏7👏4
